import ctypes,datetime,json,sys
class Status(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_=[('ac',ctypes.c_ubyte),('battery_flag',ctypes.c_ubyte),('battery_percent',ctypes.c_ubyte),('reserved',ctypes.c_ubyte),('battery_life_seconds',ctypes.c_uint32),('battery_full_life_seconds',ctypes.c_uint32)]
s=Status(); ok=bool(ctypes.windll.kernel32.GetSystemPowerStatus(ctypes.byref(s)))
result=dict(observed_at=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),ok=ok,ac=s.ac if ok else 'unknown',battery_percent=s.battery_percent if ok else 'unknown',purpose='read_only_preliminary_AC_check_not_formal_admission')
print(json.dumps(result));sys.exit(0 if ok and s.ac==1 else 2)
